title: Kyungnam University research administration system hacked; 1,202 items of user information leaked, foundation says
date_note: SBS says the foundation made its statement on the 25th; the same article says the outsider got in on the 14th and the foundation reported signs of an attack on its website on the 15th.
summary: SBS News reports that Kyungnam University's Industry-Academia Cooperation Foundation says an outsider accessed its research administration system server without authorization and took user information, 1,202 items in all. According to the foundation, the data were IDs, names, departments and employee numbers of staff and students; it says phone numbers, passwords, birth dates and resident registration numbers were not leaked.
plain: A South Korean university's research system was hacked. The foundation says 1,202 items of staff and student information were taken, but not phone numbers or passwords.
exec: The foundation says 1,202 items of staff and student data leaked from a university research system.
action: As the foundation warns, be wary of calls or texts impersonating the university that demand money or authentication numbers.
geo_basis: Kyungnam University is in Changwon; SBS does not state a city, so this is the university's seat

evidence.quote: 경남대도 해킹당했다…교직원·학생 정보 '1,202건' 유출 | 경남대학교 산학협력단이 운영하는 연구행정통합시스템이 해킹돼 이용자 개인정보 1천202건이 유출된 사실이 뒤늦게 알려졌습니다.

validation.note: Only SBS News (relaying the foundation's statement) was read; the foundation's own notice was not found.
